nodes.label: Notch Cartoon Companion (Notchy)
nodes.description: Ambient desktop creature and digital hardware companion living in the macOS display notch bezel.

nodes.label: Signature Slip & Dangle Comedy
nodes.description: Comic balance loss, dangling by fingertips, pendulum kicking, and two-arm pull up.

nodes.label: Companion Auxiliary Click Panel
nodes.description: Dedicated 48x48 pt borderless panel tracking creature body dynamically for click events.

nodes.label: Collectible Character Skins
nodes.description: Five vector skins: Mochi (marshmallow), Kuro (cat), Boba (dino), Pixel, and Cyber (LED visor).

nodes.label: Full-Screen Transparent Overlay Window
nodes.description: Full-width transparent screenSaver overlay window with 100% click-through pass-through.

nodes.label: Monkey-Bar Traversal Motion
nodes.description: Hand-over-hand traversal across bottom lip of physical notch with pinned gripping hand.

nodes.label: Curious Hover Behavior
nodes.description: Inspects nearby cursor with spring-damped pupil tracking and specular shines.

nodes.label: Two-Bone Analytical IK Solver
nodes.description: Law of Cosines kinematic limb solver anchored to TorsoBones hull normal vectors.

nodes.label: Typing Mimicry Behavior
nodes.description: Pulls out a miniature laptop and frantically mimics rapid keyboard keystrokes.

nodes.label: Den Rest Behavior (0% CPU)
nodes.description: Retreats inside physical notch bezel during focus/DND, halting all timers for 0.00% CPU.

nodes.label: Inverted Pendulum Walk Gait
nodes.description: Strict zero foot-slip bipedal locomotion where planted stance foot is locked to the ledge.

nodes.label: Music Groove Behavior
nodes.description: Wears miniature headphones and bobs head/torso to active Spotify or YouTube playback.
